programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相。

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 擁有一頭白色頭髮、不老容貌，被譽為傳奇談判專家的尹洙諾，開始了一場高風險的併購談判，拯救一度拋棄過他的公司 HM 集團。擁有精英團隊的專業人士－包括頂尖律師、會計師、行銷專家和專利專家律師的尹洙諾，利用自己無與倫比的技能去講述企業間併購的故事。

programme.title: E51
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦。

programme.title: E20
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。

programme.title: E5 - Grasslands

programme.desc: While tiger populations all around the world are crashing, tiger numbers in a remote nature reserve in Sumatra, Indonesia are increasing. programme.title: E4 - Roller Coaster Accidents
programme.desc: High-speed loops, dizzying drops, and the rush of adrenaline—roller coasters are feats of physics and design. But when safety systems fail, lives hang in the balance. In this episode, Fatal Engineering explores some of the most chilling roller coaster accidents in history, analyzing how minute mechanical failures, operator mistakes, and ignored warning signs led to serious injuries and death. Discover what these tragedies taught us about engineering safety and the balance between thrill and risk.

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: E22
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E3 - Baby John's Fun Animal Playtime!

After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car & a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

programme.title: E6 - JJ's Birthday Surprise

programme.title: E2 - Nina's Adventures with Friends
programme.desc: Join Nina on some amazing adventures with her friends! When Nina challenges her school friends to a game of soccer, she imagines herself as a true soccer star playing in a giant stadium at the World Cup! Then, she visits Grandpa's farm where she proves to be an ace tractor driver who never leaves her friends behind. From learning to share a new firetruck to going on an epic chase to get back a lost surprise egg, it's always an adventure with Nina!

programme.title: E5 - An Adventure, Pedals, Rescue & Stars!
programme.desc: Join the Minibods for an adventure with pedals, rescues & stars! Lulu goes camping but realizes she's left her favorite Binky Bunny behind & has to learn how to cope. Then, Newt goes on an adventure to find a real-life Flutterbug, but she has to be brave when her bike's stabilizers come off! The adventures continue as Jeff overcomes his fear of mud to rescue his feather duster & Bubbles builds a rocket to try & reach a big purple star in the sky!

programme.title: E4 - A Guide To Fun & Healthy Days!
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun & healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: E2 - How Awesome Things Work!
programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He & D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety & how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car & a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo & takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: E16
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: <Idol Booth> is where fans can meet their favorite idols just as both idols and fans have always envisioned them-pretty, cute, full of member chemistry, and as vivid as photocards coming to life-right before their eyes. Set against the backdrop of photo booths-a familiar place for Gen Z and Millennials to make memories with friends and a must-visit spot for many international visitors to Korea-along with the dopamine-rushing claw machine arcades, the show captures idols at their prettiest, cutest, and most energetic moments.

programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Anyone who has anything to do with the film industry in Hong Kong, must have heard of a film buff called Lil' Kim. He knows everything there is to know about filmmaking. Whether it's on the set, at the movie premiere or at a press conference, he always shows up uninvited. Nobody knows where he came from and why he showed up... Ginger Keung is the producer of a reality show who suspects Lil' Kim is in fact a film critic who pans movies to extort advertising dollars from film companies. She zeroes in on Lil' Kim as her next target and decides to dig into his elusive past...

programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Joint Security Area
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight...

programme.title: Mrs. K
programme.desc: Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K...
